text: URSAPHARM Arzneimittel GmbH, founded in 1974 and headquartered in Saarbrücken, is managed by Frank Holzer and Dominik Holzer, per the company's own profile page, which lists HYLO as its most important brand. As a GmbH it is not stock-exchange listed; this page does not itself state that the company is family-owned or otherwise describe its ownership structure beyond naming its managers.
